action: If you gave the museum personal information (tickets, membership, donations, employment, volunteering), watch for its notice and be alert to phishing; the article reports no museum advice.
date_note: Law Commentary's article is dated 21 November 2026; the filing date and the breach date are not stated beyond the breach being in September 2026.
exec: A lawsuit alleges the museum disclosed a September data breach only in November; the compromised data categories are not confirmed.
plain: A lawsuit says the Chicago History Museum had a data breach in September and told people only in November. The article says which data was affected has not been independently confirmed.
summary: Law Commentary reports a lawsuit in Cook County Circuit Court over a September 2026 data breach at the Chicago History Museum, said to have exposed personal information of customers, employees and volunteers. The complaint, as the article describes it, alleges inadequate cybersecurity and disclosure only in November. The article says the compromised categories are not independently confirmed.
title: Chicago History Museum sued over September data breach and November notice

validation.note: Single publisher (Law Commentary) describing the complaint; no museum statement read.
